args.subject: Invitation: Tuesday Evening Book Club (7 PM at Local Library)
args.body:
Hi Frank,

I hope you’re well. I’d like to invite you to our book club meetings on Tuesday evenings. We meet at 7:00 PM at the local library. Right now we’re reading mystery novels and discussing a different book each week — everyone is welcome to join, whether you’ve read the book or just want to listen and contribute.

If you can make it, we’d love to have you join us. Feel free to bring any mystery recommendations.

Best,
[Your Name]

args.subject: Invitation: Saturday Morning Farmers Market
args.body:
Hi Diana,

I’d like to invite you to the Saturday morning farmers market at the town square. It runs from 8:00 AM to 1:00 PM and has great fresh produce. If you’re interested, I’d love to see you there.

Thanks,

args.subject: Invitation: Hands-on Italian Cooking Class — Wednesday Evening
args.body:
Hi Jack,

I’d like to invite you to join a hands-on Italian cuisine cooking class at the Culinary Arts Center next week. It’s scheduled for Wednesday evening — we’d love to have you come and participate.

Details:
- What: Hands-on Italian cooking class
- Where: Culinary Arts Center
- When: Wednesday evening (next week)

Please let me know if you can make it or if you’d like more details (time, cost, registration). Hope you can join us!

Thanks,

args.subject: Invitation: Jazz Concert at the Blue Note — Friday at 8 PM
args.body:
Hi Charlie,

I’d like to invite you to a jazz concert at the Blue Note this Friday at 8:00 PM. It features a local quartet and tickets are $25.

Would you like to join? If so, I can hold a ticket for you or buy one on your behalf.

Best,
[Your Name]

args.subject: Recommendation: The Artisan Bakery
args.body:
Hi Bob,

I wanted to recommend The Artisan Bakery downtown — their sourdough bread is incredible. They bake fresh every morning at 6 AM. If you enjoy fresh bread, it’s definitely worth checking out.

Cheers,
